Users who regularly use ChatGPT for quick image searches can now use a brand new gesture to add photos to conversations more quickly. Here's how.

ChatGPT makes it easier for users to attach recently taken photos to conversations

Although iOS's Visual Intelligence feature has been available for nearly two years, it currently only supports newer iPhone models and is not available in all regions.

For users who rely on ChatGPT for similar visual searches, attaching photos used to require tapping the "+" button, selecting "Photos," and then choosing the appropriate image from the photo library.

Although this process isn't overly complicated, OpenAI has slightly streamlined it this week, allowing users to add recent photos to conversations with a handy new gesture.

According to OpenAI's Adam Fry on X, users can now long-press the "+" button on the left side of the input field to instantly bring up their four most recently taken photos.

Users can select one of these photos to attach to the conversation, then ask a question or use it as part of their prompt.

This new gesture is one of several ChatGPT improvements this week. Other updates include more accurate awareness of the current time, improved loading and execution speeds for long conversations on the web version, and clearer interface prompts when users are waiting for a network connection.

Do you use AI for visual searches? Let us know in the comments.
